programme.name: Repository Integration Blueprint
programme.determination_fail: BLUEPRINT NOT CERTIFIED — REPOSITORY MUST STOP
programme.disclosure: This blueprint is DERIVED TRUTH computed from Repository Truth at the recorded HEAD. It legislates nothing, ratifies nothing, freezes nothing and owns no capability. It creates no capability catalogue, no dependency graph, no registry, no queue and no certification authority: where a canonical owner already holds a matrix it is bound by pointer and never restated; where none exists the matrix is derived from declared machine-readable substrate; where honest derivation is impossible the absence is declared and counted. Every capability disposition is computed by an ordered, total, data-declared rule set — never asserted.

either home the missing unit or declare the edge's target in a discovery source

compliance.requirement: every capability must be covered exactly once

compliance.requirement: knowledge is recorded once, in exactly one canonical home
compliance.remediation: resolve the duplicate home through the concept-closure owner
merge the colliding units under one canonical owner, or record the collision as an authorized distinction in the declaration
break the named cycle by extracting the mediating module into the lower layer both participants already depend on
bind the orphan to a consumer, publish an interface for it, or disposition it for removal
regenerate the corpus certification through its owner and resolve the failing domain
